column3: Saori Route ・ Probing
The day after the hospital visit to Saori. Today is Marine Day, so it's a school holiday.
I don't have anything in particular to do, so I whiled away my time on the internet.
Oh, this figure... It greatly rose in value since its release.
Somehow, I was browsing an auction site, and like always, the auctioneers were waging a fierce battle.
This plastic model is also one of those that Saori passed to me.
Come to think of it, although Saori requested to keep Kirino and Kuroneko in the dark...
Did she get in touch with them?
Let's think about this logically...
If she stops contacting them suddenly after she got hospitalized, wouldn't they get suspicious?
...Should I try asking them?
What about Saori?
Well, did Saori say or do anything strange recently?
Huh? Is that the attitude you should have when asking someone something?
I want to hit her...!
But I'll hold back for now. I'll have to act humble for now.
Recently, would you have noticed anything strange about Saori?
Hmm... Come to think of it...
After the Siscaly Tournament, I suddenly received an Avatar Item data from her.
Avatar Item?
To put it simply, it allows you to attach something to your character.
Things like weapons, armor and stuff like special costumes...
Oh. Is that something great?
There are a range of good and bad Avatar Items.
There are some which you can get just by playing.
Of course, there are some which are tournament and event exclusives.
What I received was something that you get only by winning 300 online battles.
Isn't that pretty rare?
You can say that.
Saori said "I don't need it anymore", so I received it with gratitude.
Did you give her anything?
I also said "Let's trade?", but she didn't want anything...
...Isn't that weird?
Even if they're friends, it's a rare item. It's not something you can just give as a present.
Has this got something to do with her passing the otaku goods to me?
Other than that, I haven't noticed anything...
Then, did Kuroneko mention anything?
Huh? Why do you think I know anything regarding her?
R-Right!
If you know that, then don't ask weird questions.
Y-Yes...
Well, if something happened, she would tell me.
We're her only friends after all.
Recently, she's been doing well in school.
Then, was that all?
Ah, I still have one more question.
What is it?
...Well, coming from you, it's probably a pointless question.
If it is, I'll crush you with my foot.
Crush where!?
Actually, I didn't ask that.
Come on, ask your question already. I don't have that much free time.
Let's leave it at that after all.
Right now, I don't think I can get a straight answer out of her.
So? Say it already.
Sorry. It's nothing after all.
...Kay. I'm going then.
You don't have to be cold just because I didn't ask.
What does it mean when a girl wants a guy to keep something important for her?
You don't even know that? Isn't that obvious?
【Promise About The Future】, stuff like that right?
Promise about the future?
That's indeed something important that you want a guy to keep.
I still don't understand, but isn't this answer a little off?
It's not something like that...
So irritating...
If that's wrong, then why don't you go find the answer yourself?
Hey, are you an idiot? Do you want to die?
Haven't you been browsing the net too much...?
When a girl says that she's fine, what does it mean?
Huh? What's that, what do you mean?
Like, when she say "I'm fine now".
If she say "I'm fine", it means "Don't get involved any further".
Is that so?
You're involving yourself more than necessary and she thinks, "So annoying".
I don't really want to hear this...
Be considerate to avoid vexing the other party.
Either that or...
Maybe it's the opposite and she wants you to worry about her.
The opposite?
When she strongly states that she's fine... It means she wants you to worry about her...
Hm... Sorry. I don't get it at all.
Men who don't understand a maiden's heart should be exterminated!
You're going to make me cry!
Yes yes, I'm busy unlike you.
If you still have questions, maybe you could prostrate and ask the person involved?
*sigh*...
Feels like the aftermath of a storm.
Well, thanks to Kirino, I learnt something.
Somehow or another, her words are convincing.
Saori is indeed hiding something.
